assets.purpose: The Job Tracker product mark, a tick above two ledger rules. It appears at the top of the sidebar, in the phone top bar and on the login card, and the evolved PWA icons are drawn from it.
requirements: Reference as /mark.svg or inline it, at 20px in the sidebar and top bar and 32px on login
Stroke stays #1d5fbf at 1.5px with no fill and no letter in a square
Build redraws frontend/public/icon.svg and icon-maskable.svg from this mark on a #f2f4f7 or white ground, and sets theme_color and background_color in the manifest to #f2f4f7
Keep aria-label 'Job Tracker', or set aria-hidden when the product name text sits beside it
assets.composition: 20x20 viewBox, transparent background, centred optical weight, round caps: a check in the upper half (5,6.2 to 8,9 to 14.5,2.8), a full rule at y=13 from x 3 to 17, and a shorter rule at y=17 from x 3 to 12

source.license: Original mark drawn for this project

assets.purpose: Geist, the interface face for all text and figures, used at weights 400, 500 and 700
requirements: Declare @font-face with family 'Geist', src url('/fonts/Geist-Variable.ttf') format('truetype'), font-weight 100 900, font-style normal, font-display swap
Remove the Inter Google Fonts link from index.html
After document.fonts.ready, verify that document.fonts.check('500 14px Geist') is true and that tabular-nums changes digit widths
Ship frontend/public/fonts/Geist-OFL.txt beside the font. It is the SIL OFL 1.1 text downloaded from https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/geist/OFL.txt and served as text/plain
Verified: TrueType magic bytes 00 01 00 00, variable wght axis, 169,056 bytes
